goal: Make PostgreSQL a real, working, CI-verified second database backend — not just a docker-compose service and an aspirational doc claim.

phases.goal: A Postgres-capable connection layer exists behind a backend-selecting abstraction, with the design decision recorded as an ADR, and the SQLite path is provably unchanged.
definition_of_done: cmd: cd backend && cargo build --features vectors passes with the postgres feature enabled
cmd: cd backend && cargo test passes (existing SQLite-path tests unaffected)
grep: postgres in backend/Cargo.toml (the sqlx features line)
prose: backend/src/db/mod.rs no longer imports sqlx::sqlite::{SqlitePool, SqlitePoolOptions} directly at the connect() call site — it goes through the new abstraction
prose: docs/ADRs/ADR-033-postgresql-backend-support.md exists and documents the URL-scheme dispatch decision

phases.goal: All 29 migrations run clean against a real PostgreSQL 16 instance, producing a schema equivalent to the SQLite one.
definition_of_done: cmd: a throwaway postgres:16-alpine container (e.g. via docker run or docker compose) accepts `sqlx::migrate!` cleanly end to end for all 29 migrations
grep:absent: AUTOINCREMENT|PRAGMA in the Postgres-targeted migration SQL
cmd: cd backend && cargo test db:: passes
prose: the migration-set-selection logic is documented at the call site in backend/src/db/mod.rs

phases.goal: Every backend call site that talks to the database works against either backend through the phase-0 abstraction — no code path still assumes SqlitePool.
definition_of_done: cmd: cd backend && cargo build --features vectors passes
cmd: cd backend && cargo test passes
cmd: cd backend && cargo clippy --all-targets --features vectors -- -D warnings passes
grep:absent: SqlitePool in backend/src (outside the phase-0 abstraction's own internals in backend/src/db/mod.rs)

phases.goal: CI actually proves PostgreSQL works — the entrypoint secret-plumbing bug that made smoke.yml silently test SQLite while believing it tested Postgres is fixed, and a dedicated CI job runs the backend suite against a live Postgres service.
definition_of_done: cmd: cd backend && EMAILIBRIUM_DATABASE_URL=postgres://... cargo test passes locally against a throwaway postgres container (documented reproduction command)
grep: EMAILIBRIUM_DATABASE_URL in backend/entrypoint.sh (or wherever the fix lands)
prose: .github/workflows/ci.yml contains a postgres service-container job running the backend suite

prose: the CI job referenced above is green on the phase's own PR (remote CI is the authority per orchestrate's invariants — this line is verified by the gate reading real check results, not asserted)

phases.goal: The operator docs describe PostgreSQL support accurately now that it's real, closing the loop the docs-accuracy-audit pipeline opened.
definition_of_done: grep:absent: planned, not implemented in docs/deployment-guide.md (the specific phrase this pipeline makes obsolete)
cmd: just lint (or the docs-only subset: markdownlint + lychee) passes
prose: docs/deployment-guide.md's Database Strategy table reflects PostgreSQL as an available option with accurate operational notes
